author: SilasVale
body: The split depends on how many people within 25 levels of you are within your party.

author: Nousersavailable6969
body:
Party system is a perfect comparison to communism. If everyone worked really hard then it’d be faster than normal. 
But it’s not cuz people suck.
Should at least have some in game metrics to measure each other with so deadweight can be cut out

author: [deleted]
body: Having too big a party is counterintuitive when you're actively playing more than the others. You're getting lesser experience overall.

author: Driftedryan
body: If you're more active then leave the party. I did and went up faster

author: Iskabib
body: It's better to only party with 1 or 2 people. Or By yourself.

author: [deleted]
body: Im in a group with 6 and dont mind the slower xp grind. Helps me farm orn and enjoy each tier more. I will only level up once so might as well have fun on the journey
